AuthorsScreen.description: The sites' authors: each on their own at first. They are merged not by how a name is written but by their works: of two authors you see which works matched by your answers on the page of the duplicates, which may match and how likely, and the rest of the works of each. A normalized author is a feature of the comparing of the duplicates: new merges count after "Search again" there.
AuthorsScreen.title: Authors
OfferRow.differentHint: These are different authors: the pair is offered no more
OfferRow.expectedHint: The sum of the chances of the pairs of works you did not answer on: how many of them likely match
OfferRow.matchingHint: The pairs of their works you marked "one work" or "partly". Translations do not count: a translation has another author
OfferRow.sameHint: This is one author: merge them. It can be undone on the "Merged" tab
OfferRow.takeBackHint: Take "different" back: the pair may be offered again
SideHead.takeOutHint: Take this site's author out: on their own again, the pair offered no more
SideHead.worksHint: This author's works on the site
